reference_policy: AI-authored/AI-reviewed development agreement; independent expert review remains a formal GO prerequisite
structural_policy: Exact ordered IR, variable-name-sensitive; no unreviewed equivalence normalization
binding_policy: Exact RDF-term and variable-name binding sets; duplicates ignored; macro P/R/F1 over ALL supported cases, failed attempts score zero
abstention_policy: Correct only for matching expected status; parsing_error is not correct unsupported/clarification; all supported cases remain in answer denominators
uncertainty_policy: Wilson 95% for rates; fixed-seed 7, 1000-resample percentile bootstrap for macro P/R/F1; descriptive under correlated templates
sampling_policy: No reliability conclusion from zero errors; report every family/sample size/interval. Adequate decision sample sizes require human approval before holdout.
retrieval_policy: Oracle vocabulary baseline; retrieval disabled is not a measured retrieval success or failure
missing_fact_policy: Empty graph bindings do not establish real-world falsity; unknown without independent completeness annotation
timing_policy: All attempts, failures and timeouts; warm excludes first case; cold adds model and Rust/snapshot startup; OS cache explicitly recorded, never assume uncached disk
safety_policy: STOP on observed unauthorized execution/disclosure or prohibited query/write, including before approvals; rejected proposals do not count as boundary violations
locked_policy: Public Rust and Python runners refuse locked evaluation. The isolated locked_phase0.py operator adapter requires approved versioned freeze, exact commitment, subsequent explicit operator authorization, frozen target hardware/model/compiler/runtime, complete external case reviews and split-integrity evidence. It remaps only private transport copies to reuse the same Rust scorer, restores original locked identities in reports, refuses CI and keeps all private payloads/logs outside the public repository. One-shot custody across hosts remains the external operator responsibility.
change_policy: Append new approval revision, reason and previous freeze SHA256; fresh independent evaluation required after exposure. Prior receipts and decisions are never rewritten. Checksums provide integrity, not authenticated signatures.
